question: What attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation form a combined attainment
Great accomplishment is the stated result
This accomplishment brings favor with the yoginīs
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
